notes: Controlled outcome vocabulary. STANDALONE features are shown to users; HELPER features are graph plumbing between combos; HIDDEN are generator internals.
Keep this list under ~20 entries. Commander Spellbook's 1,310 features forced LOOPLINE to build a second taxonomy on top.

features.name: Infinite Energy
features.description: Unbounded Energy within one turn (the Rune Pool empties at end of turn).

features.name: Infinite Power
features.description: Unbounded Power of the deck's domains within one turn.

features.name: Infinite ready Recruits
features.description: Unbounded Recruit tokens that enter ready and can move or attack the turn they appear.

features.name: Infinite recycle / redraw
features.description: Any card in the trash can be recycled and redrawn at will (requires an empty Main Deck).

features.name: Infinite draw (liability)
features.description: Drawing past an empty deck is Burn Out and gives an opponent a point.

features.name: Score arbitrary points
features.description: Ability-granted points, which rule 470's once-per-battlefield cap does not touch.

features.name: Burst of points in one scoring event
features.description: Bounded multiplicative points that can clear the 8-point Victory Score in one Hold or Conquer.

features.name: Win the game
features.description: An effect that says you win (rule 195), or enough points to pass the Victory Score.

features.name: Repeatable card advantage on Hold
features.description: Each Hold draws, tutors or returns more than one card. An engine, not a kill.

features.name: Repeatable Gold tokens
features.description: Several Gold gear tokens per Hold. Gold is domainless (187.5) and enters exhausted, so it is next-turn Power for any legend.

features.name: Draw and ready on Conquer
features.description: Conquering with excess damage draws a card and readies a unit.

features.name: Runes readied or channeled on attach
features.description: Attaching Equipment produces rune value, capped per turn.

features.name: Force the opponent to play their deck
features.description: Repeatedly makes the opponent play cards off the top of their Main Deck, ignoring Energy costs.

features.name: Repeatable opponent Burn
features.description: Makes the opponent put cards from the top of their Main Deck into their trash, repeatedly. Pressure, not a kill: Burn Out recycles their trash before awarding a point (431.2).

features.name: Repeatable Energy or Power
features.description: Bounded Energy or Power returned by moves, readies or reveals within a turn, or held ready through the opponent's. An engine, not a loop: the Rune Pool still empties at end of turn (167).

features.name: Repeatable ready bodies
features.description: Several ready unit tokens per turn, bounded by cards in hand. Feeds a Hold, The Grand Plaza or a kill-fodder payoff; not a kill by itself.
